fusions.name: Course After Course
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 6 blood damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gorging Frenzy
fusions.desc: You tear into everything in a wide arc 3 tiles ahead of you for 26 blood damage. Every hit is a critical hit, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Laid Table
fusions.desc: Healing you receive rises by 30% for 10 seconds, and you regain 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Well Fed
fusions.desc: Whenever you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
